name: Dastarkhwan
why_it_matters: Boti kebab cooked over open charcoal, served with Mughlai paratha — Dastarkhwan's signature setup that draws Awadhi-cuisine first-timers across multiple branches. The Kaiserbagh original is the kitchen with the most consistent reviews.
insider_tip: Opens 1:30pm — does not run breakfast. Multiple namesake branches now operate (Aminabad, Gomti Nagar's Vivek Khand) — the Kaiserbagh and Vivek Khand outlets are the in-family ones; verify branch on Zomato before booking.
signature_address: 20, DM Compound Colony, Wala Qadar Road, Kaiserbagh, Lucknow 226001

name: Kakori House
why_it_matters: Gomti Nagar's specialist for the kakori kebab — the smooth-as-silk minced-meat skewer technique that originates from Kakori town just outside Lucknow. The kitchen brings the old-city kebab tradition to the eastern modern-Lucknow side of the river.
insider_tip: Order the kakori-galouti combo plate to compare the two minced-meat techniques in one sitting. Reserve for weekend dinners; the dining room is small.
